evidence.note: README describes Documenso as an open-source DocuSign alternative and discusses digitally signing documents.
Official GitHub repository metadata binds the repository identity and homepage.

items.placement_note: Existing definitions treat electronic signature as a capability within broader contract or sales-document workflows, not as a standalone signing application. Do not classify Documenso as full CLM, business-contract administration, or sales-document automation without evidence of those respective cores.
